title: Sodick LN2W post: C000 approach with wire offset, work offsets above G59, inch programs, M03 AWT jump

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

- The post refuses the C000 approach option when a section uses the control wire offset (G41 / G42). This is the #4076 decision.
- The post accepts only G54 to G59. It does not declare `workOffsetIndex`, so the engine refuses offset 7 or higher by setup name.
- The post accepts only millimetre documents, because the control alarms on G21.
- The post writes no `M03` (AWT jump) before `T90`.

## Expected

- The Sodick LN1W / LN2W programming manual gives `H000` for the approach and `H001` for the first cut. The post can write the approach on C000 / H000, then C001 / H001 at the contour.
- The manual gives more work coordinate systems than G54-G59 (G154-G159 to G954-G959). The post can declare `workOffsetIndex` and a larger `workOffsetMax`, and map each index to its word.
- The manual says that the control reads inch values when its INIT INCH setting is on. The post can write inch values with no unit word and a header note that tells the operator to set INIT INCH on.
- The manual puts `M03` (AWT jump) before `T90` in multi-hole AWT programs. The post can write it as an option when `edm.awt` is true.

Each item needs a confirmation from the AQ600L owner before it is written.

## Evidence (upstream main `eafe6aec6`)

- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:63`: `programUnits = "mm"`.
- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:369-370`: the C000 refusal.
- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:434`: `/^G5[4-9]$/`.
- `crates/post/src/post/work_offset.rs:96-101`: the engine refusal above offset 6.
- `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:52`, `:706`: `M03` is never written; `T90` stands alone.
- `docs/decisions/4045-sodick-ln2w-dialect.md` and the #4076 decision.

Found by the post audit against the Sodick manuals (#4130).

## Done means

- Each item is written or stays refused by name, and a decision entry says which and why.
- Each written item has a golden under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/sodick-ln2w/`.
